title: Accounts Payable
description:

£16 to £19.30 per hour
Monday to Friday, 9-5

We're recruiting multiple Accounts Payable roles to join a busy finance team within a brilliant Leicestershire-based business.

With multiple positions available, interviews are taking place immediately and we're particularly keen to speak with candidates who are available at short notice and can start ASAP.

If you're looking for your next Accounts Payable opportunity and want to join a brilliant team, apply today for immediate consideration.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
- Finance Assistant
- 2-3 Month Temp, chance to go permanent
- £30-35k, hybrid, immediate start

Finance Assistant
Do you want a job where the ledger actually balances by the time you go home? We're looking for a Finance Assistant to cover a busy period, initially for 2-3 months, full time, hybrid, with a genuine chance of the role going permanent for the right person. You'll take real ownership of the transactional side of the finance function, invoices, credit cards and sales ledger, working alongside budget holders and the wider finance team.
This one suits someone who already knows their way around a busy finance desk and wants to get stuck in from week one. You'll need to be quick with numbers, comfortable picking up new systems, and genuinely careful with the detail, because a lot of what lands on this desk needs to be right first time, not fixed later.

What You Will Be Doing
- Processing purchase orders, invoices, petty cash and credit card transactions day to day, keeping everything moving at pace.
- Checking every entry has proper authorisation before it goes anywhere near the finance system.
- Managing supplier relationships, sorting out queries as they come up and keeping payments running to terms.
- Helping put together the weekly payment run, with everything checked and authorised at each stage.
- Working through company credit card statements line by line, matching every transaction to what's been posted.
- Chasing overdue accounts through calls and standard letters, and flagging the ones that need pushing further up.
- Handling internal recharges between departments accurately and on schedule.
- Getting the bank reconciliation done on time, coding everything correctly as you go.
- Carrying out due diligence on any new supplier, including independently verifying bank details before that first payment is made.
- Being a point of contact for more junior colleagues, showing them the ropes on purchasing processes.

What We Need From You
- Available immediately or on a short notice period, this cover is needed straight away.
- A genuinely careful approach, this role handles a high volume of transactions and mistakes aren't easily hidden.
- Experience in a fast-moving office where you're used to juggling priorities.
- A finance background with hands-on purchase ledger, sales ledger or similar transactional experience.
- Comfortable learning a new finance system quickly if ours isn't one you've used.
- Able to work independently but just as happy mucking in as part of a team.
- Confident communicating with people at every level of the business, not just within finance.
- AAT or equivalent hands-on experience.
- Willing to undergo an enhanced DBS check, this is required for the role.

What's in it for you
- A real shot at a permanent role if you're the right fit, this isn't cover for the sake of it.
- Hybrid working.
- Exposure to a growing, varied organisation.
- No two days looking quite the same.
- Proper support and training while you find your feet.
- A team that will genuinely have your back.
- On-site parking.

If you're someone who takes pride in getting the numbers right, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Payroll Coordinator
description:
Are you a detail-driven Payroll Coordinator looking to Join our dynamic hospitality team as a Payroll Coordinator where you'll not only ensure people are paid accurately and on time but also play a key role in supporting the wider HR and finance function.

Position Purpose
- The Payroll Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the accurate, timely, and compliant delivery of end-to-end payroll for a high-volume UK workforce. This role focuses on maintaining payroll integrity, statutory compliance, and high-quality reporting while overseeing payroll controls, resolving complex queries, and supporting continuous system improvements.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
- End-to-End Payroll Delivery
- Execute accurate and timely end-to-end payroll processing
- Manage the full employee payroll lifecycle, including starters, leavers, and contractual variations.
- Calculate and process all statutory payments (including SSP, SMP, SPP) and holiday pay in strict accordance with UK legislation.
- Process BACS payments and maintain robust payroll controls, validation procedures, and audit checks.
- Data Integration & Systems Management
- Download, validate, and reconcile data from the automated time and attendance (T&A) system against final payroll outputs.
- Administer and maintain employee records within core enterprise HR and payroll databases.
- Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies, system errors, and escalated employee queries.
- Reporting, Compliance & Analysis
- Produce comprehensive payroll, labour cost, pension, National Insurance, bonus, and commission reporting.
- Partner with HR and Finance teams to deliver ad-hoc data analysis and management information (MI).
- Guarantee strict adherence to GDPR, data confidentiality protocols, and statutory payroll regulations.
- Support internal and external payroll compliance and audit requirements.
- Process Improvement
- Proactively identify opportunities for process enhancement, automation, and efficiency gains.
- Support the implementation of system workflows and automation tools.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
- Experience & Technical Skills
- High-Volume Payroll: Proven track record of managing end-to-end payroll data
- Systems Competency: Strong proficiency in standard mainstream UK payroll software and mid-to-large-tier Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) HR platforms.
- Advanced Excel: Advanced data manipulation capabilities, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data cleansing, and exception reporting.
- Desirable Assets: Prior experience working with automated time & attendance software and workflow automation tools (e.g., Power Automate) is highly advantageous.
- Core Competencies & Attributes
- Exceptional attention to detail with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy.
- Strong organizational and time-management skills; capable of hitting rigid deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex financial or payroll data for non-finance stakeholders.
- High level of professional integrity, discretion, and problem-solving capability.

Employment Terms & Benefits
- Work Arrangement: 100% In-person
- Perks: Free on-site parking, casual dress environment, and corporate/store discounts.
